expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.I===0 && S.alpha===90 && S.magneetti==='A' && Math.abs(S.l-5)<1e-9 && Math.abs(S.lukema-245.30)<1e-9 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: I = 0, alpha = 90°, magnet A, l = 5,0 cm, reading 245,30 g (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='-6' && R[0].max==='6' && R[0].step==='0.5' && R[1].min==='0' && R[1].max==='90' && R[1].step==='5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: I −6…6 A in steps of 0,5, alpha 0–90° in steps of 5
selects: magnet A/B, length in the field 2,5/5,0 cm

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='I,alpha,l,magneetti' && P.I.unit==='A' && P.l.unit==='cm' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares I (A), alpha, magneetti and l (cm)
